display_name: Athanasius the Recluse of the Caves

names.note: Read out of saint.gr's line for 2 Δεκεμβρίου, «Όσιος Αθανάσιος ο Έγκλειστος “ἐν τῷ Σπηλαίῳ”», with the rank word left off. The two epithets in this folder's name are the page's own, «ὁ Ἔγκλειστος» and «ἐν τῷ Σπηλαίῳ».

Read out of the Охридски пролог’s fourth heading for 2. децембар ст. ст., „Преподобни Атанасије, затворник печерски.“ — «Преподобни» is the `venerable` grade and comes off, and everything after the comma is what the book prints to tell this Athanasius from the others, with its own comma and its own lower case kept rather than tidied. Section 6 wants the fullest form the calendar gives and a bare forename beside a fuller one is a fold the gate stops on: the bare «Атанасије» is already on four folders, and затворник is not a rank this corpus keeps in `types`, so it belongs in the form. `sr-foldpred.mjs` measures this form at 0 other holders.

Read out of the `name:` link behind days.pravoslavie.ru’s line for 2 декабря ст. ст., name page 303, «Преподобный Афанасий, затворник Печерский», with the rank word left off. The comma and the word order are the page’s own and are load-bearing here: the same day’s second name page, 304, reads «Преподобный Афанасий Печерский, затворник» and belongs to a different man, the recluse of the Far Caves of the thirteenth century, who now has his own folder. «затворник» is not a grade this corpus keeps in `types` and «Печерский» is the monastery, so both stay in the form, on the same reading the `sr` form already on this folder stands on.

feast.note: His two life pages list «28 сентября (Печер.(Б)), 2 декабря» — the second being the synaxis of the saints of the Near Caves — and one of them adds the second Sunday of Great Lent. The day page that names him is the 2 декабря one, so that is the day recorded here; the synaxis and the moveable Sunday are recorded and he does not render on either.

source.text: Православный церковный календарь, Сретенский монастырь (days.pravoslavie.ru), 2 декабря ст. ст. — «Прп. Афанасия, затворника Печерского, в Ближних пещерах (ок. 1176)»

attestations.note: Not checked: doxologia.ro's calendar for the same civil day (2 October 2026).

source.text: saint.gr, το εορτολόγιο της 2ης Δεκεμβρίου — «Όσιος Αθανάσιος ο Έγκλειστος “ἐν τῷ Σπηλαίῳ”»

attestations.note: The life page heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 2 Δεκεμβρίου εκάστου έτους», the same day as the listing. No asterisk and no «Δεν είναι διασταυρωμένη» sentence on the page, and it prints no hymn, no distich and no year. Its whole entry is one sentence. The corpus keeps fifteen other folders of the Caves of Kyiv and none of them is this man; the page says «στην Λαύρα των Σπηλαίων», the Lavra of the Caves, and does not say which lavra, so the folder's name follows the page's own words and claims nothing more.

source.text: Православни подсетник (pravoslavno.rs), Охридски пролог за 15.12.2025 (2. децембар ст. ст.) — „Преподобни Атанасије, затворник печерски.“

attestations.note: The day’s fourth entry of five, and an upgrade: the folder exists, carried a venerated GREEK row for the same 2 December and nothing else, and the menologion scan found it. Quoted whole with its closing full stop (section 4); URL year 2025. THE SWEEP RETURNED 370 ATHANASII AND SETTLED NOTHING; what settled it is that the heading names the Caves — «затворник печерски», the recluse of the Kyiv Caves — and the corpus holds exactly one Athanasius of the Caves, this one, whose display name is that same phrase in English and whose Greek row stands on this same menologion day. `types` UNTOUCHED: «Преподобни» is the `venerable` the folder holds, and the `monk` and `wonderworker` beside it came from the Greek page. Затворник, a recluse, is NOT a type: section 5’s table has Пустињак and Отшелник for `hermit` and the corpus keeps no `recluse`, so the word stays in the name form and the prose and nothing was added. `office` UNTOUCHED — none. `dates` WRITTEN FOR THE FIRST TIME: the folder held `dates: null`, and this book closes „Упокоји се у Господу 1176. године.“ so `death` is 1176 with equal bounds and `traditional` basis. Nothing was widened and nothing contradicted, because there was nothing there. Unlocated, and it stays unlocated: the Caves are in the name and not a coordinate the reader may set. WHAT THE BOOK ADDS, AND IT IS THE WHOLE OF THE FOLDER’S STORY: the death after a long asceticism, the washing and clothing and preparation for burial, the two days lying dead, the coming alive, the brethren finding him sitting up and weeping, and the twelve years afterwards shut in a cell on bread and water alone without a word to anybody. NOBODY IS NAMED IN THE ENTRY AT ALL and no `related` row is owed in either direction. The Prologue prints no troparion and no kontakion. NO FOLD: the bare «Атанасије» WOULD HAVE MADE ONE OF FIVE — `foldchk.py` finds it on athanasius-i-of-constantinople, athanasius-of-attaleia, athanasius-once-a-magician and athanasius-the-reader — and was refused for that reason; `sr-foldpred.mjs` measures the fuller form the heading actually gives at 0 other holders.

death.note: The Охридски пролог for 2. децембар ст. ст. closes „Упокоји се у Господу 1176. године.“ — the only year any source has given this folder; it held no `dates` at all before. The entry gives no year of birth and no age (7 October 2026).

hymns.text: Блаженство плачущих получити желая,/ день и нощь непрестанно плакал еси,/ имея во уме час Судный,/ тем по кончине твоей обрел еси утешение на Небеси,/ преподобне Афанасие./ Подаждь и нам плакатися зде грехов наших выну,/ яко да плача безконечнаго избывше,/ тамо приимем вечное утешение.

source.text: Православный церковный календарь, Сретенский монастырь (days.pravoslavie.ru), 2 декабря ст. ст. — «Тропарь преподобного Афанасия, затворника Печерского, в Ближних пещерах»

english.text: Desiring to obtain the blessedness of those who mourn, you wept without ceasing day and night, holding the hour of judgement in your mind; and so after your end you found comfort in heaven, venerable Athanasius. Grant us also to weep here for our sins always, that escaping unending weeping we may receive eternal comfort there.

hymns.text: Яко безсмертия тезоименит, по умертвии своем востал еси жив;/ показуя же, яко зело люта есть смерть, плакался еси горько./ Ныне, обретши некончаемую радость,/ молися о нас, яко да плача вечнаго избудем.

source.text: Православный церковный календарь, Сретенский монастырь (days.pravoslavie.ru), 2 декабря ст. ст. — «Кондак преподобного Афанасия, затворника Печерского, в Ближних пещерах»

english.text: Named for immortality, you rose up alive after your own death; and showing how very bitter death is, you wept bitterly. Now that you have found unending joy, pray for us, that we may escape eternal weeping.
